description: Fifth Dual design: shared_pool with Hamming-packed halves (min pairwise ≥6), G<10%, HP≤5. Pseudo-replicate structure (4×4 blocks) of the printed Dual layout.
notes: Halves packed to min pairwise Hamming ≥6 (7000 codes; seed 44).
minH 7 under G<10%/HP≤5 only yields ~4400 codes — short of unique bar_1 for 5369 blocks; minH 6 enables unique bar_1.
Same 4×4 shared-pool structure as legacy Dual; distance is on the predefined half library.
